# Sahar Azar Music Studio

> Private clarinet and saxophone lessons in Aurora, Ontario, Canada, serving students from Aurora, Newmarket and Richmond Hill, taught by Sahar Azar, an RCM (Royal Conservatory of Music) verified teacher. Lessons for all ages and levels, in person, online (Zoom/Skype) or hybrid. A free 30-minute trial lesson is available.

## Lessons
- Clarinet: classical and contemporary repertoire, technical exercises and etudes, RCM examination preparation.
- Saxophone: jazz and classical training, improvisation techniques, performance preparation.
- RCM exam preparation: structured preparation, mock examinations, performance technique coaching.
- Formats: in-person studio lessons in Aurora, online lessons via Zoom or Skype, or hybrid.
- Students give regular recitals and concert performances.

## About the teacher
- Over 17 years of academic music training and more than 10 years of teaching experience.
- Studied at the Tehran Music School from grade 6, graduating in Clarinet Performance; post-secondary major in Clarinet Performance.
- First place in Clarinet Performance at the 2002 Fajr Music Festival (Iran's National Music Competition).
- Assistant Principal Clarinetist with the Tehran Symphony Orchestra for two years.
- Freelance musician in Toronto; has performed with the University of Toronto Wind Symphony, UofT Wind Ensemble, UofT Clarinet Choir and the Markham Symphony Orchestra.
- Masterclasses with Prof. Jim Campbell, Richie Hawley, Yehuda Gilad, Peter Stoll, Susan Hoppener and the Berlin Philharmonic Wind Quintet; primary teacher Prof. David Bourque since 2012.
